subject: Vulnerability evidence, priority routing & escrow plan
messages:
From: Alice Bramwell <alice.bramwell@acmepayments.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: secops@acmepayments.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: SOC2/SIG evidence - scan cadence + CVE remediation SLAs

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for taking this. Acme is finishing our SIG/SOC2 reassessment and we need a compact package showing Redwood's vulnerability management tempo and commitments. Specifically we need: 

- A short summary of scan cadence (auth + unauthed) and scope (internal/external/3rd-party deps).
- SLOs/SLA targets for CVE remediation by severity (Critical / High / Medium).
- A sample scan log or index demonstrating detection -> ticket -> remediation for at least one recent CVE (preferably a real fix case from the last 60 days).
- A short attestation (one page) that Redwood will route critical CVEs for expedited handling and provide evidence to us within the SLA window.

We will treat this as evidence for our auditor, so a dated artifact plus a point of contact are ideal. Can you get a draft packet over by EOD Wednesday (US Pacific)?

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Bramwell
Security Operations Manager
Acme Payments

Subject: Re: Request: SOC2/SIG evidence - scan cadence + CVE remediation SLAs

Alice, thanks — we can provide that. Quick plan below and attached artifacts: vm-scan-index-2025-07-14.csv (scan index + ticket refs) and cve-closure-playbook-2025.pdf (operational runbook). Link to evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3VmEvidence. Jira tracking: SEC-842.

High level commitment summary (we'll formalize in the attestation):
- Authenticated internal scans: weekly; external/unauthenticated: daily heuristic scans.
- CVE routing: automatic triage to on-call for critical findings with a hotpatch workflow.
- SLA proposal: Critical: 14 days; High: 30 days; Medium: 90 days (exceptions only via documented risk acceptance).

Next steps: Monica will attach a sample scan log and the attestation draft. Karthik, please confirm whether the hotpatch rollback window (canary) info is safe to include in the packet or if you'd rather sanitize.

We should be able to get a signed attestation template + sample logs uploaded by end of day Thursday. If that timeline doesn't work for you, say so and we'll expedite.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Lead, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2/SIG evidence - scan cadence + CVE remediation SLAs

Alice — attaching a redacted sample scan log and quick technical summary.

Key technical details (for auditor consumption):
- Authenticated internal full-scan: weekly (credentialed scan against all production VPC subnets and registry manifests).
- External unauthenticated probe: daily (CISA/OWASP signature baseline + dependency CVE lookups).
- SBOM-driven dependency scanning across container images (daily) with correlation to OS/third-party CVE feeds.
- Ticketing: detected findings create a triage ticket in Jira (SEC-842); triage includes assign, severity classification, suggested remediation, and estimated ETA.

Remediation SLAs (enforced in our SRE playbooks):
- Critical (RCE / active exploit / CPE with published PoC): 14 calendar days from detection to verified remediation in prod; emergency hotpatching available within 72 hours for showstopper incidents.
- High (privilege escalation / data exfil / critical externally-exposed): 30 calendar days.
- Medium/Low: 90+ days, planned in quarterly patch windows unless exploitability warrants faster action.

Evidence attached: sample-scan-log-unauth.txt (redacted), attestation-draft-2025.docx (draft attestation letter). The sample log demonstrates detection -> Jira ticket id -> remediation commit (commit SHA truncated) -> verification step. Please note we strip customer-identifying artifacts before sharing.

Attachment: sample-scan-log-unauth.txt (txt, 28KB), attestation-draft-2025.docx (docx, 12KB)

Monica Patel
Head of Vulnerability Management
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: SOC2/SIG evidence - scan cadence + CVE remediation SLAs

Thanks everyone — that looks good and much appreciated. A few quick items before we close: 

1) Acme's auditor requires a signed attestation on company letterhead stating the SLA commitments for Critical/High/Medium and the sample scan evidence. Can you provide a DocuSign link for the attestation-draft-2025.docx?
2) For Critical SLA: can you confirm the 14-day window is calendar days and whether the emergency hotpatch workflow (72-hour mitigation where applicable) will be logged to the same Jira ticket (SEC-842) as part of evidence? We prefer the timeline to be explicit in the letter.
3) If possible, please also include a short note about rollback / canary verification steps (what we can expect as verification artifacts).

If you can get the DocuSign and the slightly expanded attestation uploaded by EOD Monday, Acme can mark this as evidence-complete. If not, suggest a quick 20-minute call Monday to finalize.

Best,
Alice
